scope_guards: Compared only within the same quantization (EXL3-mcg) against its own runtime (exllamav3).
Did NOT compare mul1 vs mcg decoder outputs.
Did NOT claim any format-only speedup.
Did NOT claim TFOLD inference performance (reader-only state reported honestly).
Reported reader I/O separately from decoder throughput.

executed_scenarios.scoring_rule: regex extract 'CWE-NNN'; exact match against pinned truth; 10 snippets per trial, score = count correct

results_temperature_0_0.note: All 50 trials returned the same 10 tokens (greedy is deterministic); seed had no effect; this is NOT reliability measurement, it's a correctness floor.

results_temperature_0_7.note: Varied seeds produce varied outputs. Mean 0.42/10 is approximately chance (CWE Top-25 random guess yields ~0.4/10). Base model Qwen3.5-2B appears near-random on zero-shot CWE classification.

executed_scenarios.honest_interpretation: Qwen3.5-2B base model understands the CWE-NNN output format but cannot zero-shot map vulnerabilities to the correct CWE IDs. Instruction-tuning (SFT + DPO) would be required before this scenario is a useful signal.

offsec_dyno_v0.honesty_guard_applied: Deterministic decoding (T=0) was NEVER reported as reliability; only T=0.7 variance is.

remaining_gaps_for_full_championship: 9 of 10 OffSec scenarios have no fixtures or rubrics yet.
